# google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy

An AutoProtectionPolicy automates backup management by applying a backup plan to all
eligible resources that match the policy's criteria, instead of protecting each resource
individually. A policy takes effect only after it is attached to a scope, such as a
project, with a `google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy_binding`.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about AutoProtectionPolicy, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/backup-disaster-recovery/docs/reference/rest/v1beta/projects.locations.autoProtectionPolicies)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/backup-disaster-recovery/docs)

## Example Usage - Backup Dr Auto Protection Policy Basic


```hcl
resource "google_backup_dr_backup_vault" "my_backup_vault" {
  provider                                   = google-beta
  location                                   = "us-central1"
  backup_vault_id                            = "bv-app"
  backup_minimum_enforced_retention_duration = "100000s"
}

resource "google_backup_dr_backup_plan" "my_backup_plan" {
  provider       = google-beta
  location       = "us-central1"
  backup_plan_id = "bp-app"
  resource_type  = "compute.googleapis.com/Instance"
  backup_vault   = google_backup_dr_backup_vault.my_backup_vault.id

  backup_rules {
    rule_id               = "rule-1"
    backup_retention_days = 5

    standard_schedule {
      recurrence_type  = "HOURLY"
      hourly_frequency = 6
      time_zone        = "UTC"

      backup_window {
        start_hour_of_day = 0
        end_hour_of_day   = 24
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy" "my-auto-protection-policy" {
  provider                  = google-beta
  location                  = "us-central1"
  auto_protection_policy_id = "app"

  criteria {
    matching_conditions {
      label_condition {
        key    = "env"
        values = ["prod"]
      }
    }
  }

  backup_plan_details {
    resource_type = "compute.googleapis.com/Instance"
    backup_plan   = google_backup_dr_backup_plan.my_backup_plan.name
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Backup Dr Auto Protection Policy Full


```hcl
resource "google_backup_dr_backup_vault" "my_backup_vault" {
  provider                                   = google-beta
  location                                   = "us-central1"
  backup_vault_id                            = "bv-app-update"
  backup_minimum_enforced_retention_duration = "100000s"
}

resource "google_backup_dr_backup_plan" "instance_backup_plan" {
  provider       = google-beta
  location       = "us-central1"
  backup_plan_id = "bp-app-update-vm"
  resource_type  = "compute.googleapis.com/Instance"
  backup_vault   = google_backup_dr_backup_vault.my_backup_vault.id

  backup_rules {
    rule_id               = "rule-1"
    backup_retention_days = 5

    standard_schedule {
      recurrence_type  = "HOURLY"
      hourly_frequency = 6
      time_zone        = "UTC"

      backup_window {
        start_hour_of_day = 0
        end_hour_of_day   = 24
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy" "my-auto-protection-policy" {
  provider                  = google-beta
  location                  = "us-central1"
  auto_protection_policy_id = "app-update"
  description               = "Protects production VMs."

  criteria {
    matching_conditions {
      label_condition {
        key    = "env"
        values = ["prod"]
      }
    }
  }

  backup_plan_details {
    resource_type = "compute.googleapis.com/Instance"
    backup_plan   = google_backup_dr_backup_plan.instance_backup_plan.name
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `criteria` -
  (Required)
  The criteria that a resource must meet to be protected by the policy.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_criteria).

* `backup_plan_details` -
  (Required)
  The backup plans to apply to the resources that match the policy's criteria. Each entry
  specifies a resource type and the backup plan that protects resources of that type.
  Currently, only one entry is supported.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_backup_plan_details).

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the auto protection policy.

* `auto_protection_policy_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the auto protection policy. This becomes the final component of the policy's resource name.


* `description` -
  (Optional)
  A description of the auto protection policy.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_criteria"></a>The `criteria` block supports:

* `matching_conditions` -
  (Required)
  A list of matching conditions that a resource must meet to be protected by the policy.
  Currently, only one condition is supported.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_criteria_matching_conditions).


<a name="nested_criteria_matching_conditions"></a>The `matching_conditions` block supports:

* `label_condition` -
  (Optional)
  A condition that matches resources based on their labels.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_criteria_matching_conditions_label_condition).


<a name="nested_criteria_matching_conditions_label_condition"></a>The `label_condition` block supports:

* `key` -
  (Required)
  The key of the label to match.

* `values` -
  (Required)
  The values of the label to match. A resource matches the condition if its label
  value is equal to any of the listed values. Currently, only one value is supported.

<a name="nested_backup_plan_details"></a>The `backup_plan_details` block supports:

* `resource_type` -
  (Required)
  The type of resource that this policy automatically protects, for example
  `compute.googleapis.com/Instance` or `compute.googleapis.com/Disk`.

* `backup_plan` -
  (Required)
  The resource name of the backup plan to apply to the matching resources, in the format
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/backupPlans/{backup_plan_id}`. The backup plan
  must be in the same location as the auto protection policy.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/autoProtectionPolicies/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the auto protection policy, in the format
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/autoProtectionPolicies/{auto_protection_policy_id}`.

* `state` -
  The current state of the auto protection policy.
  Possible values are `CREATING`, `ACTIVE`, `UPDATING`, and `DELETING`.

* `etag` -
  The etag of the auto protection policy, used for optimistic concurrency control.

* `create_time` -
  The time when the auto protection policy was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time when the auto protection policy was last updated.

* `policy_evaluation_summary` -
  A summary of the last run of the job that applies the policy to matching resources.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_policy_evaluation_summary).

* `binding_summary` -
  A summary of the scopes that the policy is applied to through bindings.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_binding_summary).


<a name="nested_policy_evaluation_summary"></a>The `policy_evaluation_summary` block contains:

* `matching_resource_count` -
  (Output)
  The number of resources that currently match the policy's criteria.

* `protected_resource_count` -
  (Output)
  The number of matching resources that are successfully protected.

* `failed_resource_count` -
  (Output)
  The number of matching resources whose protection failed during the last job run.

<a name="nested_binding_summary"></a>The `binding_summary` block contains:

* `project_count` -
  (Output)
  The total number of projects protected by the policy.

## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


AutoProtectionPolicy can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/autoProtectionPolicies/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import AutoProtectionPolicy using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    autoProtectionPolicyId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import AutoProtectionPolicy using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/autoProtectionPolicies/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}"
  to = google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), AutoProtectionPolicy can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/autoProtectionPolicies/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}
$ terraform import google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}
$ terraform import google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy.default {{location}}/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}
```
